video_title: ESPN’s Brian Windhorst: What T’Wolves Adding LaMelo Means for Anthony Edwards | The Rich Eisen Show

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Timberwolves' roster strategy and Anthony Edwards' late-game performance
quotes.excerpt: Anthony Edwards was walking down to the Spurs bench and congratulating them on their on the winning the series.

text_blocks.speaker: Rich Eisen
text_blocks.text: What are the Timberwolves up to? Did they just decide, all right, this group that we have, we got the coach, we got Ant-Man, and we have a couple of players that we don't want to part with as well, but the rest of it, let's go.

text_blocks.speaker: Brian Windhorst
text_blocks.text: Let's take the last time we saw the Timberwolves on the court. With eight minutes to go, Anthony Edwards was walking down to the Spurs bench and congratulating them on their on the winning the series. Maybe that's one of the reasons why the Spurs were not ready for the last eight minutes of these Knicks games. Because when the Knicks got to eight minutes and they were behind, that's when they went for the kill and Ant brought down the white flag. If you're seeing that, and also remember, they traded Karl-Anthony Towns. From the minute Karl-Anthony Towns got traded, Ant Edwards has been relentlessly double-teamed.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: LaMelo Ball as a potential solution for Timberwolves' double-team issues
quotes.excerpt: LaMelo is a mystery, he has not had almost any playoff history whatsoever and he's got an injury history.
quotes.quote: They tried to go for Giannis, they couldn't get him. They looked into some other players, they couldn't get them. The guy that they could get was LaMelo. LaMelo is a mystery, he has not had almost any playoff history whatsoever and he's got an injury history that is worrisome. But my gosh, is he a double-team buster and a great guy to put alongside Ant. You double-team Ant now, you do so at your own peril. They can share, they can play off the ball with each other. They're going to be highly entertaining to watch. They still have an all-time great defensive center back there to sort of help them out. Jaden McDaniels, who had this big, big, remember he told everybody on the Nuggets is a bad defender and ran his mouth and then went out and scored like 38. It increases his role, that's a fallout of it, it increases his role.
